research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: inBuild is focused on developing a system that enhances financial automation for home builders. The system includes a database designed to store and manage data related to emails, projects, vendors, and invoices. This technology aims to streamline business accounting processes by automating the handling of financial documents and transactions, thereby improving efficiency in accounts payable operations. This aligns with inBuild's mission to provide intelligent financial solutions tailored for the home building industry.

overview_description.description:
inBuild is a SaaS company looking to change the way construction accounts payable is approached from the ground up. We offer construction businesses an intelligent accounts payable solution unlike any other on the market. Bridge the growing gap between email and legacy software: extract incoming invoices, capture data fields, and route documents to the right team members for review. All that data flows seamlessly into the project budget to provide real-time, system-wide visibility into the financial health of any given project. Spend less time on manual data entry and leverage project data to improve your accounts payable. Save time, money, and increase accuracy by allowing artificial intelligence to handle the tedium.

inBuild is the construction industry's most intelligent accounts payable solution.

product.name: inBuild Accounts Payable Hub
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates accounts payable workflows for construction projects, including invoice processing, document management, and payment reconciliation.

product.name: inBuild Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that allows users to capture, review, and approve financial documents and invoices on the go for construction projects.

product.name: inBuild Pay Applications
product.description: A tool to generate customizable pay applications quickly for construction projects, streamlining owner invoicing and payment processes.

product.name: inBuild Document Management and Automation
product.description: Automated processing, storage, and management of construction financial documents including invoices, contracts, change orders, and lien waivers.

product.name: inBuild Integrations
product.description: Integration services that connect inBuild with external financial and project management software such as Procore, QuickBooks Desktop, QuickBooks Online, and DocuSign.
